presidentMessage.title: President’s Message
presidentMessage.text1: Mr. Hassan Rezk, President of Association Najm, welcomes you to the association’s official platform, dedicated to the economic and professional empowerment of youth.
presidentMessage.text2: Convinced that youth are the engine of change, the association focuses on training, mentoring and continuous support to strengthen their participation in economic and social life.
presidentMessage.text3: Guided by values of respect, transparency, equality and collaboration, it develops innovative programs and expands partnerships to become a national and regional reference, inspiring young people to become the leaders of tomorrow.

aboutTeaser.title: Who We Are
aboutTeaser.text: Founded in 2020, Association Najm is a non-profit organization committed to the future of Moroccan youth. It fights unemployment, promotes socio-economic inclusion and develops educational, cultural and social programs. With an experienced team and local and international partnerships, Najm offers young people opportunities for training, support and empowerment to help them become drivers of change.

items.q: How can I join the association?
items.a: Contact us via the contact form or visit our headquarters in Moulay Rachid – Sidi Othmane.

items.q: Do you support young project leaders?
items.a: Yes. Our Irchad platforms provide personalized support to structure, finance and launch projects.

items.q: Are the trainings free of charge?
items.a: Yes. They are offered free thanks to the support of our institutional partners.

items.q: Can I get funding for my project?
items.a: Some projects may receive financial support after evaluation, notably within the INDH framework.

items.q: What types of projects do you support?
items.a: Projects with strong social or economic impact: cooperatives, self-entrepreneurship, community initiatives.

items.q: Who can benefit from your services?
items.a: Youth aged 18 to 45 residing in the Moulay Rachid – Sidi Othmane area with an idea or a project to develop.

items.q: How does the support process work?
items.a: After an initial meeting, we set up a support plan including training, coaching sessions and personalized follow-up.

platformManagement.title: Management and Administration of Guidance Platforms
platformManagement.intro:
Association Najm has been managing youth guidance and employment platforms in the Moulay Rachid neighborhoods since 2020, spaces dedicated to supporting and economically integrating young people within the framework of Program 3 of the third phase of the National Initiative for Human Development (INDH).

The guidance platform, thanks to its management model developed by Association Najm, has become a reference in youth economic integration, with total commitment to the spirit of INDH. It stands out as a dynamic space that brings together various institutions, organizations and programs dedicated to youth.

Association Najm relies on an efficient and transparent governance methodology, based on clear and smooth decision-making mechanisms. The association has developed a procedures guide covering all management operations, and aims to obtain quality certification for its administrative processes and recognition as a public utility association.

socialEconomy.title: Social and Solidarity Economy Support Axis
socialEconomy.intro:
Since 2021, Association Najm has been responsible for implementing the "Social and Solidarity Economy Support" axis at the Moulay Rachid prefecture level. This axis aims to support and strengthen the capacities of social and solidarity economy actors, with particular emphasis on cooperatives subject to law 112.12, as well as on various economic actors active in this field.

Thanks to this initiative, Association Najm provides comprehensive support to cooperatives and social entrepreneurs by offering them administrative and management training, strengthening technical and artisanal skills, and financing opportunities. The goal is to strengthen their development opportunities, increase their competitiveness and promote their economic integration for sustainable and inclusive development.

services.title: Key Role of the Association
services.description: Association Najm plays a central role in supporting project leaders and economic actors in the social and solidarity economy. It regularly organizes project proposal calls, receives and studies applications from candidate organizations, and accompanies entrepreneurs throughout the preparation and development stages of financial aid requests.

services.title: Business Plan Support
services.description: As part of its commitment to supporting economic development, Association Najm accompanies project leaders in developing their Business Plans. It provides them with tools and advice to structure their ideas, improve their economic model and prepare effective presentations before the Provincial Committee for Economic Development (CPDE), which evaluates the feasibility and relevance of projects.

services.title: Post-Validation Follow-up and Financing
services.description: After project validation by the CPDE, Association Najm continues to provide support by accompanying project leaders in the administrative procedures necessary to obtain financial aid. It ensures compliance with conditions required by subsidized organizations and helps them prepare and submit necessary documents within deadlines, thus ensuring smooth and rapid reception of funds.

services.title: Post-Financing Follow-up
services.description: Association Najm's role is not limited to granting financing, but extends to meticulous follow-up after financing, where it continues to support project leaders during the implementation phase. This support includes advice on management, marketing and business development, helping to ensure the sustainability and growth of enterprises. The goal is to accompany these projects towards long-term success and strengthen their economic and social impact within the community.

fieldWork.title: In the field with cooperatives
fieldWork.description: As part of our ESS mission, we regularly conduct proximity visits, practical workshops and training sessions to support cooperatives in their administrative, commercial and technical procedures. These actions strengthen their professionalization and sustainable economic integration.

entrepreneurship.title: Strengthening Youth Entrepreneurship
entrepreneurship.intro:
Thanks to the competence of its members and the constant commitment of its organizational structure, Association Najm contributed to the call for expressions of interest launched by the Moulay Rachid prefecture in November 2023, concerning the implementation of the youth entrepreneurship support axis.

The excellence of the application file presented by the Association enabled it to gain the confidence of the selection committee and the Governor, this confidence was materialized by the assignment of this strategic mission to Association Najm. The Association thus signed two partnership agreements for 2024, in the territory of the Moulay Rachid prefecture.

These two agreements aim to train 200 young people in the pre-business creation phase and to support 115 entrepreneurs in the post-creation phase during 2024.

items.title: Work Methodology
items.description: The association has adopted a work methodology based on organizing pre-defined training cycles (each quarter), interspersed with a set of continuous monitoring and evaluation mechanisms. These cycles conclude with periodic meetings of the Provincial Human Development Committee (CPDH), to allow INDH governance structures to monitor the level of achievement and attainment of set objectives.

items.title: Pedagogical Approach
items.description: Association Najm adopts a modern pedagogical approach focused on andragogy, specially designed to meet adult learning needs. This approach is reinforced by applied and interactive training based on real case treatment, according to the principle of "Learning by doing". This journey is supervised by a permanent pedagogical team, which ensures precise support and training quality, through continuous communication with experts and professionals, which strengthens learning effectiveness and guarantees concrete results.

sections.title: For an Inclusive Digital Transformation in Morocco
sections.text: Association Najm for Economic Inclusion believes that digital transformation represents both a challenge and a promising opportunity for Morocco. Limited access to modern technologies, the lack of suitable training and a widening digital divide are among the main barriers hindering youth integration into the digital economy. Yet digitization offers great possibilities to stimulate entrepreneurship, create job opportunities and energize the socio-economic fabric—especially for out-of-school and unemployed youth who are not in training and face real obstacles to professional integration. Aware of this reality, Association Najm is committed to supporting youth in acquiring digital skills, advancing the digitalization of businesses and encouraging technological innovation. By focusing efforts on these fundamental pillars, the association aims to help build a more inclusive development model.

sections.title: An Academy Serving Morocco's Digital Future
sections.text: Through this Academy, Association Najm offers young people economic-integration opportunities in a high-potential sector: digital professions—fully aligned with the national drive for digital transition.

sections.title: Strategic vision of the association
sections.text: Since its creation, Association Najm continues its development to strengthen professional integration and youth entrepreneurship.\n\nWith rigorous governance, a structured team and efficient monitoring tools, it diversifies its actions and adapts its programs to economic and digital changes. It places continuing education, partnerships and post-training support at the heart of its sustainable strategy.

introduction.title: ✨ General Introduction
paragraphs: Association Najm today inaugurates an ambitious digital training program, the result of its continued commitment to the economic and social empowerment of youth.

Aware of the growing importance of digital technology in all sectors of activity, the association has designed a training path structured around three complementary areas: Web Development, Digital Marketing, and Visual Design and Creation.

These trainings aim not only to transmit technical and practical skills, but also to stimulate creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and innovation among young people. Through this project, Association Najm wishes to open new professional perspectives, encourage competitiveness and actively contribute to digital inclusion.

webDevelopment.title: 💻 Web Development Training
paragraphs: The Web Development training constitutes a central pillar of the program. It aims to give participants the tools and knowledge necessary to design and develop modern, dynamic and secure websites.

Learners will be introduced to programming languages (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) as well as the most used frameworks and libraries in the industry. They will also discover the principles of responsive design, best practices in accessibility and integration of collaborative tools.

This training will offer young people the opportunity to prepare for various digital professions: front-end developer, web integrator, or creator of digital solutions for local businesses. By encouraging innovation and practice, it paves the way for entrepreneurship and the creation of technology start-ups.

digitalMarketing.title: 📢 Digital Marketing Training
paragraphs: In a world where online visibility has become essential, Digital Marketing training offers young people to master modern communication and promotion strategies.

On the program: social media management, creation of engaging content, natural referencing (SEO), online advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Facebook Ads), email marketing, and performance analysis via specialized tools.
This training will allow participants to develop a deep understanding of consumer behavior and learn to design effective campaigns.

It is aimed at those who wish to become community managers, digital marketing managers, communication consultants or launch their own entrepreneurial project. By giving the keys to modern commerce, this training prepares youth to play an active role in local and national economic development.

visualDesign.title: 🎨 Visual Design and Creation Training
paragraphs: The Visual Design and Creation training is dedicated to artistic expression and visual innovation. It aims to develop the skills necessary to create modern, attractive visuals adapted to the digital world.
Learners will be introduced to the basics of graphic design, typography, colors, as well as the use of professional tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator or Figma.

Particular attention will be paid to UI/UX design, essential for designing intuitive and pleasant user interfaces, as well as creating various visual media: logos, posters, advertising banners and content for social networks.

This training offers young people the opportunity to become graphic designers, web designers or independent visual content creators, while strengthening their sense of creativity and their ability to meet market needs.

conclusion.title: 🌟 Conclusion
conclusion.text: Through these three trainings, Association Najm confirms its role as a catalyst for talent and skills in the digital field. The objective is clear: to offer young people the means to build a solid professional future, to actively participate in digital transformation and to become agents of change in their community.

festival.title: Youth Cultural Festival
paragraphs: Association Najm organized the first Youth Cultural Festival, a major event that brought together more than 500 young participants from different regions. This event was designed to celebrate cultural diversity and promote the artistic talents of young people.

The festival offered a rich program including traditional dance performances, contemporary music concerts, visual arts exhibitions and creative writing workshops. This event allowed young people to express themselves freely and share their creations with a wide audience.
The impact of this event was felt well beyond its duration, creating lasting bonds between participants and inspiring new cultural projects in their respective communities.

workshops.title: Personal Development Workshops
paragraphs: As part of its "Youth and Leadership" program, the Association has set up a series of personal development workshops for young people aged 16 to 25. These workshops cover essential themes such as self-confidence, effective communication and stress management.

Led by personal development experts and certified coaches, these workshops use innovative teaching methods combining theory and practice. Participants benefit from personalized support and concrete tools to develop their potential and achieve their projects.

activities: Organization of citizen debates on contemporary societal issues, allowing young people to express their opinions and develop their critical thinking
Setting up an artistic creation contest on the theme "My vision of the future", encouraging creative expression and forward-thinking reflection
Creation of a network of young cultural ambassadors responsible for promoting the association's initiatives in their schools and universities
citizenship.impact: This innovative program has raised awareness among more than 300 young people about the values of active citizenship and social responsibility, while enhancing their creativity and community engagement.
